g.title: LIMITS
g.text: Limits of this debugger (facts from the design)
- one hardware breakpoint (core has one trigger)
- no software breakpoints: imem is read-only for the core
- the image cannot be loaded through the debugger (AXI loader does it)
- no memory read while the core runs (SBA not connected)
- accelerators keep running while the core is halted
- Vivado and OpenOCD cannot share the USB-JTAG at the same time
